observation_note: Public GET snapshots collected over several minutes, not an atomic health check.
scope: Read-only official status/model metadata and local adapter inspection. No API keys, authenticated requests, completions, inference probes, tests, paid routes or runtime/configuration edits.

official_status.limitation: Gateway-wide status does not establish that an individual model endpoint is available. No claim about incident history or account-specific quota is made.

free_candidates.compatibility: Catalog and endpoint advertise the parameters sent by the current JSON-object adapter. Schema conformance, Russian extraction quality, latency and account access have not been tested.
A second explicit free model with a different reported upstream from Phala, Nvidia and Google AI Studio. Availability and NLU are not established by this listing.

nvidia_free_snapshot.limitation: Raw status and rolling uptime are recorded without inventing an undocumented status-code label. This is consistent with endpoint-level availability trouble, not proof of the cause of a particular 5xx.

reasoning_diagnosis.request_shape_condition: For LLM_REASONING_ENABLED=false as reported by root; when unset, the adapter omits enabled.
confirmed: The adapter adds enabled only when LLM_REASONING_ENABLED is configured; it always requests exclude=true.
The public Nvidia free catalog has mandatory=false and advertises reasoning plus response_format/structured_outputs.
Official docs distinguish exclude=true (hide reasoning output) from disabling reasoning; enabled=false is a supported reasoning control.
The repaired report records Nvidia HTTP_ERROR in 323-790 ms, not REQUEST_TIMEOUT. The local wall-timeout branch produces REQUEST_TIMEOUT.
The current harness permits HTTP_ERROR fallback only for a 5xx status, so a following backup attempt supports that inference; the exact Nvidia HTTP status/body is not present in this report.
reasoning_diagnosis.conclusion: No static incompatibility of the current reasoning/JSON parameters is established. A provider/gateway translation bug cannot be excluded, but claiming reasoning caused the failures would be unsupported. Fast 5xx and the free endpoint status snapshot support investigating upstream availability first.
reasoning_diagnosis.suggested_non_inference_followup: Keep only sanitized http_status/provider_name/limit_source or error type in failure audit to distinguish future routing/parameter errors from provider 5xx; never retain keys, raw HTTP bodies or hidden reasoning.

retain_guards: At most two model attempts per run
Do not bypass account/key/workspace/unknown quota limits
Record actual model and each attempt
proposed_emergency_configuration.next_step: Root may perform a separately authorized bounded harness call after checking remaining quota. A listing or a successful metadata GET is not inference success or NLU acceptance.

cautions: No benchmark-based superiority claim or recommended paid provider.
Use the :free endpoint URLs. The catalog's canonical links.details can enumerate paid endpoints or an empty non-free listing and must not be substituted for free-variant availability.
The current adapter uses JSON-object mode with application validation; advertising structured_outputs does not itself enable strict JSON Schema mode.
No live model call, test request, key read or runtime/configuration change was made in this inspection.
